releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.Web3CoreOASIS v2.0.5

WEB4 OASIS API Web3Core OASIS Provider is one of the many WEB2/WEB3 providers that plug in and integtate into the OASIS.

What's new since v2.0.4
- Add and verify Web3Core presence and payload checked upserts (80cf90e)
- Add bounded Web3Core record enumeration and native page checks (c0b7d5a)
- Add checked encrypted record history to V2 EVM providers (aa48e66)
- Add explicit Fantom canonical-at-read CQL and verified local demo (16018cf)
- Add explicit Sei block-hash codec and verified native CQL walkthrough (05f436b)
- Add native Arbitrum public balance CQL with fixed official RPC path (dd827e4)
- Add native TON TVM contract proof and fix unsupported CQL capability reporting (0ea8699)
- Apply Web3Core paired avatar lifecycle atomically with payload checks (5565889)
- Bind Ethereum storage preparation to durable usage outbox (a69e95e)
- Bind explicit EVM preparation scopes to usage persistence before submission (a3d1efd)
- Correct Web3Core native nearby coordinate units and errors (5b57ba8)
- Document reusable durable preparation integration and correct provider completion claim (135e315)
- Enable verified public Arbitrum and Polygon wallet balances (f0ef621)
- Encrypt Web3Core canonical records with authenticated identity (c6d6c92)
- Expose existing prepared provider implementations through shared Core capability (257b8dc)
- feat(evm): share exact id-bound escrow and preserve custody ownership (11c3572)
- feat(web3core): send exact native coin through value-bound signed observer (23a2aa5)
- Fix Web3Core avatar detail contract routing and record EVM gaps (cbab849)
- fix(evm): cancel owned status HTTP requests per operation (87426f6)
- fix(evm): capture search scope before collection awaits (bbd1ae8)
- fix(evm): preserve exact private history JSON object values (8508fdc)
- fix(evm): require shared exact ERC721 transfer receipt proof (4de4d55)
- fix(evm): resolve export identities independently of holon versions (692efff)
- fix(evm): share authorized default mint wallet selection across providers (7b3756f)
- fix(evm): share bounded exact wallet history without silent block skipping (6cc8f18)
- fix(evm): share validated native balance reads and activation (5614b11)
- fix(evm): verify native NFT mint evidence and expose token identity (9a1e5c3)
- fix(web3): bind mint metadata and collection to admitted intent (b7e3af3)
- fix(web3): enforce exact ERC721 transfer quantities in API and contract (e68ccad)
- fix(web3): freeze NFT request intent before async admission (91e914b)
- fix(web3): honor explicit ERC721 collection targets and share nonce gate (4fe55ca)
- fix(web3): honor NFT owner signing keys without bypassing preparation (05ef7ba)
- fix(web3): preserve captured roles and guard acknowledged caller publication (aab8f2a)
- fix(web3): preserve signed preparation and native identity for NFT burns (ac79397)
- fix(web3): preserve uint256 NFT token IDs and reject fractional transfers (5a75877)
- fix(web3): reject stale callers and colliding graph keys before dispatch (cd83cfe)
- fix(web3): report returned-root counts across shared reads (02db336)
- fix(web3): retain NFT collection title and loaded status (7b0fbca)
- fix(web3): verify NFT recipient ownership and retain failed postcondition evidence (cadb19e)
- fix(web3core): burn requested exact amount through shared signed engine (e1f4319)
- fix(web3core): implement Polygon and Arbitrum credential selectors (617a551)
- fix(web3core): mint explicit exact tokens through signed native observer (1eb6baa)
- fix(web3core): verify exact signed ERC20 transfers including self sends (069c528)
- Gate EVM broadcast through shared closed preparation owners (53d0d1a)
- Guard Web3Core holon deletion by full identity and payload hash (179d3c1)
- Honor Web3Core single-holon graph read options (6161c3b)
- Implement bounded owned-holon CQL in shared Web3Core V2 provider (6b79516)
- Implement explicit Filecoin native identity and CQL balance source (0c7df54)
- Import and export Web3Core holons through authenticated native storage (4d69c74)
- Include Web3Core private storage implementation and tests (2dd77f0)
